label: QMI8658A tilt estimator
info: Reads a QMI8658A every 100 ms and estimates roll and pitch with a complementary filter: the gyro rate is integrated for the fast response and the accelerometer gravity vector (roll/pitch from atan2) corrects the slow drift. Demonstrates 6-DOF tilt estimation. The function node keeps its state in the node context, so the first message after deploy starts from the accelerometer-only angles.

name: Complementary-filter roll/pitch
